entries.title: Isaiah 26:1
segments: ¶In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: "We have a strong city; [God] will appoint salvation [for] walls and bulwarks.

entries.title: Isaiah 26:2
segments: Open the gates, That the righteous nation which keeps the truth may enter in.

entries.title: Isaiah 26:3
segments: You will keep [him] in perfect peace, [Whose] mind [is] stayed [on You], Because he trusts in You.

entries.title: Isaiah 26:4
segments: Trust in the LORD forever, For in YAH, the LORD, [is] everlasting strength.

entries.title: Isaiah 26:5
segments: ¶For He brings down those who dwell on high, The lofty city; He lays it low, He lays it low to the ground, He brings it down to the dust.

entries.title: Isaiah 26:6
segments: The foot shall tread it down-The feet of the poor [And] the steps of the needy."

entries.title: Isaiah 26:7
segments: The way of the just [is] uprightness; O Most Upright, You weigh the path of the just.

entries.title: Isaiah 26:8
segments: Yes, in the way of Your judgments, O LORD, we have waited for You; The desire of [our] soul [is] for Your name And for the remembrance of You.

entries.title: Isaiah 26:9
segments: With my soul I have desired You in the night, Yes, by my spirit within me I will seek You early; For when Your judgments [are] in the earth, The inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.

entries.title: Isaiah 26:10
segments: Let grace be shown to the wicked, [Yet] he will not learn righteousness; In the land of uprightness he will deal unjustly, And will not behold the majesty of the LORD.

entries.title: Isaiah 26:11
segments: LORD, [when] Your hand is lifted up, they will not see. But they will see and be ashamed For [their] envy of people; Yes, the fire of Your enemies shall devour them.

entries.title: Isaiah 26:12
segments: ¶LORD, You will establish peace for us, For You have also done all our works in us.

entries.title: Isaiah 26:13
segments: O LORD our God, masters besides You Have had dominion over us; [But] by You only we make mention of Your name.

entries.title: Isaiah 26:14
segments: [They are] dead, they will not live; [They are] deceased, they will not rise. Therefore You have punished and destroyed them, And made all their memory to perish.

entries.title: Isaiah 26:15
segments: You have increased the nation, O LORD, You have increased the nation; You are glorified; You have expanded all the borders of the land.

entries.title: Isaiah 26:16
segments: LORD, in trouble they have visited You, They poured out a prayer [when] Your chastening [was] upon them.

entries.title: Isaiah 26:17
segments: As a woman with child Is in pain and cries out in her pangs, When she draws near the time of her delivery, So have we been in Your sight, O LORD.

entries.title: Isaiah 26:18
segments: We have been with child, we have been in pain; We have, as it were, brought forth wind; We have not accomplished any deliverance in the earth, Nor have the inhabitants of the world fallen.

entries.title: Isaiah 26:19
segments: Your dead shall live; [Together with] my dead body they shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in dust; For your dew [is like] the dew of herbs, And the earth shall cast out the dead.

entries.title: Isaiah 26:20
segments: ¶Come, my people, enter your chambers, And shut your doors behind you; Hide yourself, as it were, for a little moment, Until the indignation is past.

entries.title: Isaiah 26:21
segments: For behold, the LORD comes out of His place To punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity; The earth will also disclose her blood, And will no more cover her slain.
